Apex Ronin

AI systems that show their work.

AI agents write confident reports. We check them against the code, the primary records and the law, and build pipelines where every claim traces back to a source you can re-fetch.

Services

AI output audit. Send us what your agents produced: a report, a dashboard, a set of findings. We verify each claim against the source code, the original records and the statute text, and return a case-by-case verdict with evidence, plus a list of what could not be verified.

Evidence-first pipelines. Public-records collection built API-first. Every record is stored with its source URL, fetch time and hash. Reports are generated from that ledger by code, not written by a model.

Agent guardrails. Rules and checks that keep multi-model agent teams honest: no claim without evidence, fail closed on errors, no agent grading its own work.

What an audit finds

A recent audit covered an AI-generated compliance report: 15 flagged violations, a seven-figure exposure estimate, and a "10-agent" architecture. Checked against live state records, statute text and the code itself, none of the 15 findings held up as stated. The exposure figure came from a formula, not the law, and several named components were never installed. That is the failure mode we look for, before it reaches a client or a contracting officer.
